segments.text: I will start with the quarter's customer progress.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: How many paid organizations are active now?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We have forty-two, up from thirty-one in June.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Is the Northwind deal included in that count?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: No, procurement has not signed yet.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: What remains open in that negotiation?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Legal is reviewing the renewal notice and exit window.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Does the twelve thousand dollar quote still hold?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Yes, with fifty seats and onboarding included.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: What is the runway at the current burn rate?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Seventeen months, assuming no new funding.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: And if we add the platform engineer?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: It falls to roughly fourteen months.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: That seems manageable if retention holds.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: What did churn look like this quarter?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: One small customer left after their own product shut down.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Do you have evidence that expansion is working?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Three customers added seats, and two upgraded support.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: What is the major delivery risk this autumn?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The Atlas migration has document-link validation risk.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: When is that due to finish?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The planned cutover is October thirty-first, with a November seventh fallback.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: How will you know it is safe to proceed?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The October rehearsal must pass account totals and link checks.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Please include those metrics in the next board packet.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will add the checksum report and rollback rehearsal result.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: What is the hiring decision timeline?
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: References for Linh finish this week; no offer is approved yet.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Keep the hiring plan tied to migration capacity.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Agreed. We will decide after the references.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Send the revised forecast before the board meeting.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will send it by next Tuesday.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Thank you. The risk reporting is clear.
segments.speaker: remote
